# Development and testing for the FalseObituary shiny app's function section

Loading Libraries
```{r}
#|message: FALSE
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(here)

```

Loading TidyTuesday Fictional PowerRanking data
```{r}
#Code comes from the TidyTuesday Github
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load(2026, week = 45)

fiction_citations <- tuesdata$fiction_citations 
  
fiction_deaths <- tuesdata$fiction_deaths |>
  write_csv(here("Week_12","shiny","FalseObituary","data","fiction_deaths.csv"))

fiction_rankings <- tuesdata$fiction_rankings



```

Exploring the data
```{r}
str(fiction_citations)
str(fiction_deaths)
str(fiction_rankings)
```

Displaying a table of your selected hero
```{r}

fiction_deaths_clean <- fiction_deaths |>
  select(victim, killer, year, confidence, undone, verdict)


```
